verses.en: For the Leader. A Psalm of David.

verses.he: יַֽעַנְךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה בְּי֣וֹם צָרָ֑ה יְ֝שַׂגֶּבְךָ֗ שֵׁ֤ם׀ אֱלֹהֵ֬י יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.en: The LORD answer thee in the day of trouble; The name of the God of Jacob set thee up on high;
Send forth thy help from the sanctuary, And support thee out of Zion;
Receive the memorial of all thy meal-offerings, And accept the fat of thy burnt-sacrifice; Selah
Grant thee according to thine own heart, And fulfil all thy counsel.

verses.he: נְרַנְּנָ֤ה׀ בִּ֘ישׁ֤וּעָתֶ֗ךָ וּבְשֵֽׁם־אֱלֹהֵ֥ינוּ נִדְגֹּ֑ל יְמַלֵּ֥א יְ֝הוָ֗ה כָּל־מִשְׁאֲלוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: We will shout for joy in thy victory, And in the name of our God we will set up our standards; The LORD fulfil all thy petitions.

verses.he: עַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֗עְתִּי כִּ֤י הוֹשִׁ֥יעַ׀ יְהוָ֗ה מְשִׁ֫יח֥וֹ יַ֭עֲנֵהוּ מִשְּׁמֵ֣י קָדְשׁ֑וֹ בִּ֝גְבֻר֗וֹת יֵ֣שַׁע יְמִינֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Now know I that the LORD saveth His anointed; He will answer him from His holy heaven With the mighty acts of His saving right hand.

verses.he: אֵ֣לֶּה בָ֭רֶכֶב וְאֵ֣לֶּה בַסּוּסִ֑ים וַאֲנַ֓חְנוּ׀ בְּשֵׁם־יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣ינוּ נַזְכִּֽיר׃
verses.en: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses; But we will make mention of the name of the LORD our God.

verses.he: הֵ֭מָּה כָּרְע֣וּ וְנָפָ֑לוּ וַאֲנַ֥חְנוּ קַּ֝֗מְנוּ וַנִּתְעוֹדָֽד׃
verses.en: They are bowed down and fallen; But we are risen, and stand upright.
Save, LORD; Let the King answer us in the day that we call.
